the parallelization of a sequential algorithm for constructing HVDs.
the parallel and sequential computation of Hausdorff distance Voronoi diagrams (HVDs) and Hausdorff Distance Voronoi diagrams with Obstacles (HVD-O).
the parallel and sequential construction of Hausdorff diagrams.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present the first parallel HVD algorithm, the first parallel HCD algorithm, a new sequential HCD algorithm, and the first sequential HVD algorithm for non-crossing segments.
we present the first parallel and sequential algorithms for constructing Hausdorff (and hence, regular) Voronoi diagrams of non-crossing objects.
our parallel algorithm for HVDs is the first parallel algorithm that computes HVDs for a large class of objects in sub-quadratic time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
parallel computing techniques can be applied to problems in computational geometry to improve the running time of sequential algorithms.
parallel algorithms for HVDs are feasible and that they can lead to faster sequential algorithms.
